stories.title: FAA has lifted its third-ever nationwide ground stop
stories.take: The FAA lifted its third-ever nationwide ground stop Friday evening, with Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blaming obsolete equipment — but airport chaos continued well after flights were cleared to move.

stories.title: Starship flight 15 powers to orbit—setting up a possible catch on Saturday
stories.take: Starship Flight 15 powered to orbit Friday, setting up a possible booster catch on Saturday — the 407-foot rocket is expected to circle Earth about 14 times over 22 hours first.

stories.title: Microsoft outage shakes up companies, schools and local governments across US
stories.take: Outlook started resuming Friday, but companies, schools and local governments warned some services were still down — the outage that began Thursday afternoon is still not fully closed out.

stories.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
stories.take: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on your behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers — agentic commerce just got a checkout button.

stories.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
stories.take: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang; VCs and founders say his departure leaves a big hole, with smaller checks and lower valuations likely ahead.

stories.title: Windows 0-day dropped by disgruntled researcher hands hackers System rights
stories.take: A disgruntled researcher dropped 'SignDrop,' a Windows 0-day that lets local users gain all-powerful System rights — patch watch is now on Microsoft.

stories.title: Twitch debuts shoppable, skippable ads as TwitchCon feels growing pains
stories.take: Twitch debuted shoppable, skippable ads around TwitchCon — a pair of products meant to make the livestream service a full-funnel buy, not just an awareness play.

stories.title: AI is turning ad tech into a fight for the brain behind the buy
stories.take: As AI automates ad workflows, Digiday says the contest is shifting to who owns the decisions behind the buy — the brain, not the button-pushing.

stories.title: Target’s New CMO Wants the Brand To Get Its Edge Back
stories.take: About two months into the job, Target's new CMO lays out how the retailer gets back to the forefront of culture — Target wants its edge back.

stories.title: Lyft Is Testing a Prominent New Ad Placement
stories.take: Lyft is testing letting brands take close to full ownership of the home screen riders see before booking — prime real estate, sold as a takeover.

stories.title: Mattel brings Barbie, Hot Wheels to TikTok Shop
stories.take: Mattel's TikTok Shop debuts this week with roughly 20 products across Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price and Monster High — the toy aisle moves into the feed.

stories.title: Election Advertising Drove 10% of Viewers to Seek Ad-Free Options
stories.take: Election ad saturation pushed 10% of viewers to seek ad-free options, a survey found — many others muted ads or switched channels entirely.

stories.title: Cade authors NBA's first 50-point, 10-assist, 0-turnover game in 2OT thriller
stories.take: Cade Cunningham had 52 points, 11 assists and zero turnovers as Detroit outlasted Washington in double overtime Thursday — the first 50-point, 10-assist, 0-turnover game in NBA history.

stories.title: Murray wants trade from Pelicans; both sides working on resolution
stories.take: Dejounte Murray wants out of New Orleans, and both sides are working on a resolution after he vented about the franchise in deleted posts — the Pelicans' slide continues.

stories.title: Redick says Lakers' Reaves day-to-day with left heel bruise
stories.take: Austin Reaves is day-to-day with a left heel bruise, JJ Redick said Friday — a watch item for the Lakers, not yet a longer absence.

stories.title: Warriors' Curry out at least 2 weeks with oblique injury, could miss a month
stories.take: Stephen Curry is out at least two weeks with an oblique tear and could miss a month, testing Golden State's hot start.

stories.title: Former lottery pick McDermott retires after 12 NBA seasons
stories.take: Three-point specialist Doug McDermott retired after 12 NBA seasons with seven teams — the former lottery pick closes a long shooter's career.

stories.title: Cubs' Crow-Armstrong, Astros' Alvarez sweep votes as unanimous MVP winners
stories.take: Pete Crow-Armstrong and Yordan Alvarez were unanimous MVP winners — Alvarez after nearly winning the Triple Crown, Crow-Armstrong after a breakout third full season.

stories.title: Brewers' Misiorowski, Yanks' Schlittler crowned unanimous Cy Young winners
stories.take: Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski and New York's Cam Schlittler swept all 30 first-place votes each to win their Cy Young Awards — a unanimous pitching pair.

stories.title: Sources: Bauers parlays career season into 4-year, $58M contract with Red Sox
stories.take: Jake Bauers parlayed a career season and a World Series run with Milwaukee into four years and $58M with Boston — the winter's first big free-agent move.

stories.title: Braves bolster bullpen, reach 3-year, $35 million deal with Phillips
stories.take: Atlanta bolstered its bullpen with Evan Phillips — three years, $35M for the reliever who appeared in 31 games for the Dodgers last season.

stories.title: Blue Jays' Santander apologizes for sharing anti-Muslim posts
stories.take: Anthony Santander apologized for sharing anti-Muslim videos, saying the content caused hurt and he should have been more thoughtful about what he shares.

stories.title: All passengers and crew accounted for after New Orleans boat crash in ‘miracle on the Mississippi’
stories.take: All passengers and crew were accounted for after a tanker hit the river cruise ship American Heritage in New Orleans — 32 people went to hospitals, none critically hurt, in what the mayor called a 'miracle on the Mississippi.'

stories.title: Mamdani and Trump agree to delay on food stamp rules that put benefit at risk for millions
stories.take: Mayor Mamdani struck a deal with Trump for a 90-day delay on new SNAP rules, giving bodegas and corner stores nationwide time to comply before benefits were put at risk.

stories.title: Bessent accuses Lutnick of failing to prevent China from obtaining Nvidia chips
stories.take: Treasury Secretary Bessent accused Commerce Secretary Lutnick of failing to prevent China from obtaining Nvidia chips — the Huang fallout is now a public fight inside the cabinet.

stories.title: Does Van Hollen have enough support to beat Schumer in Senate leadership race?
stories.take: Van Hollen's challenge forces a debate over Democrats' mandate after the midterms — PBS asks whether he actually has the votes to beat Schumer for Senate leader.

stories.title: Supreme Court will consider Trump's executive order suspending asylum access at the southern border
stories.take: The Supreme Court will consider Trump's executive order suspending asylum access at the southern border; lower courts found blocking asylum applications illegal.

stories.title: Trump-backed Maga firebrand Lauren Boebert defeated in Colorado congressional race
stories.take: Lauren Boebert lost her Colorado House seat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher — another Trump-backed incumbent gone in a rough midterm cycle for Republicans.

stories.title: Increasing cost of housing squeezes Americans out of market
stories.take: Rising housing costs are squeezing Americans out of the market — PBS looks at how the affordability crunch is reshaping who can buy at all.

stories.title: Longtime Northern California congressman ousted by political newcomer
stories.take: Self-funding newcomer Eric Jones edged out longtime Rep. Mike Thompson in the Democrat-on-Democrat race for Northern California's 4th District — a generational upset.

stories.title: Voters pass Proposition 42, barring new taxes on personal assets
stories.take: Proposition 42 passed with just over 51% in favor and about 96% of votes counted, barring new taxes on personal assets in California.

stories.title: FBI disrupts crypto theft scheme by North Korean hacking group; billions stolen so far
stories.take: The FBI disrupted a crypto theft scheme by a North Korean hacking group targeting crypto executives, Web3 firms and open-source developers — billions have been stolen so far.

stories.title: O.C. sheriff investigates whether employees alerted ICE before man's arrest
stories.take: Orange County's sheriff launched an internal investigation into whether two employees tipped ICE agents who detained a man leaving the county jail.

stories.title: Driver in suspected DUI crash that killed North Hollywood vendors charged with murder
stories.take: Ihor Demianenko, 61, was charged with murder Friday for a suspected DUI crash that killed three food vendors outside a North Hollywood Metro station.

stories.title: California governor Gavin Newsom endorses global fossil fuel phaseout
stories.take: At COP31, Newsom explicitly endorsed a global fossil fuel phaseout, saying California is '100%' behind the Santa Marta coalition — the most prominent U.S. voice in a process the Trump administration is boycotting.

stories.title: Flights Grounded Across the U.S.
stories.take: FAA grounded departing U.S. flights over an air-traffic communication issue — planes already airborne continued, travelers faced hours-long delays, first such halt since the 2023 NOTAM outage • Microsoft outage in broad recovery after Outlook/Teams went down for hundreds of thousands; technical issue, not a cyberattack • Nvidia fell almost 13% for the week, losing over $500B in market cap; Nasdaq -0.9%, S&P -0.4% • Fed under Kevin Warsh moves to fewer rate decisions — 8 this year, 7 next, 6 in 2028

stories.title: Washington Is Taking Control of AI
stories.take: The host frames Huang's exit as Washington forcing him out: chip controls vaulted to the top of the lame-duck agenda, likely riding the must-pass defense bill, and GOP leaders call passage a high probability • The strategy fight: sell China older GPUs to keep it dependent and behind, versus total denial pushing China down its own hardware path — years of the first approach left Chinese models less than nine months behind • Huang is set to testify in a closed House hearing before Thanksgiving; Commerce Secretary Lutnick is in the line of fire over slow-rolled export enforcement • Counter-narrative: CNN sources say intelligence collected so far does not prove Alice Huang was spying — the host says the real question is whether Nvidia knowingly broke export controls

stories.title: The Fed vs. AI inflation
stories.take: Inflation came in hot again on CPI and PPI, and it is broadening — half of CPI components are now rising 3% or more over 12 months • Fed Governor Waller's stated test for backing a possible half-point hike next month was met by the data; Chicago Fed President Goolsbee called the report 'borderline disturbing' • AI investment itself is adding inflation — chip prices pushing up phones, computers and consoles, plus energy and labor pressure, an effect likely to linger 12–24 months • Nvidia's Tuesday earnings are framed as 'galactic' in importance — panelists call the company the central bank of the AI economy

stories.title: An inflation scare, workers get their fair share, and Nvidia’s billion-dollar affairs
stories.take: CPI rose 0.4% in October, hotter than expected on food and energy; Goolsbee called it 'borderline disturbing' and said tariff effects have not faded • $960 million in stolen wages was recovered for workers in 2025 (EPI) — and that is only the recovered slice; low-wage workers in construction, food service and retail are most exposed • Nvidia lost about $465 billion in market value (stock down ~11%) since the Huang affair news broke, amid the alleged Megaspeed chip-to-China angle; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, with earnings next week

stories.title: Why a $2 Billion Law Firm Suddenly Collapsed
stories.take: The answer: Weil Gotshal did not collapse from losses or debt — profits were still rising, but its profits-per-partner rank fell from 9th in 2020 to about 20th in 2025 while it stayed mid-sized as clients moved to huge platforms • Rainmakers left with personally loyal clients, triggering a 'partner run' like a bank run: revenue left faster than fixed costs could be cut, and clawback risk made staying worse for each next partner • Partners voted to dissolve; landlords are the biggest creditors, including 10 years left on the General Motors Building lease

stories.title: Investing in Financial Security: Masters in Business with Salim Ramji
stories.take: Vanguard CEO Salim Ramji — the firm's first outsider CEO, formerly BlackRock's iShares chief — says financial security is personal: his immigrant parents ran a grocery store in British Columbia • The Vanguard effect: fees cut on 53 funds for about $250M in annual investor savings, average expense ratio 0.06%, client assets about $12.5 trillion • Only 1 in 5 Americans has a fee-based advisor; Ramji says an advisor's biggest value is behavioral, and the Altruist acquisition targets that access gap • Vanguard's cash-flow test excludes crypto, meme stocks and gold as investments, and private markets must 'load' against a simple index 60/40 before they earn a place
